carpet.rule.safeSave.name: Safe Save
carpet.rule.safeSave.desc: Save scheduled ticks and block events at the end of each complete server tick. Record level-31/32 chunks and load them before automatically resuming simulation on restart.
carpet.rule.safeSaveTicketDuration.name: Startup ticket duration
carpet.rule.safeSaveTicketDuration.desc: Server ticks to retain startup loading tickets; default 1200.
carpet.rule.safeSaveForceUnfreezeTimeout: Maximum server ticks to wait for chunk loading after the first real player joins. 0 (the default) disables the loading barrier entirely: no freeze, no loading tickets.
carpet.rule.safeSaveTicketTimerFromFirst: Start ticket timer on first player
When enabled, count ticket duration from the first real player joining; otherwise count from unfreeze.
safesave.message.startup_frozen: [SafeSave] Loading chunks active at the last save. Game ticks are frozen; the wait lasts at most %s server ticks after the first real player joins.
safesave.message.startup_unfrozen: [SafeSave] Startup loading wait ended; game ticks have resumed.
